title: Graded Nakayama freeness criterion
statement: Let k be a field and S=k[x_0,x_1] with total-degree grading and irrelevant ideal S_+=(x_0,x_1), in the convention [def-sc-p1-standard]. If N is a finitely generated graded S-module and Tor_1^S(N,k)=0 [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules] (equivalently, the kernel of a minimal finite graded free presentation has zero quotient by S_+), then N is graded free, hence a finite direct sum of shifts S(d) [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] (2).
